lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer jo naam samaane su(n)n rahiaa liv soee ||4||4||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, whoever is absorbed in the Naam remains lovingly absorbed in the Primal, Absolute Lord. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tumh mo kau door karat hau tau tum mukat bataavahu ||
lines.translation: If You keep me far away from You, then tell me, what is liberation?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਰਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek anek hoi rahio sagal mahi ab kaise bharamaavahu ||1||
lines.translation: The One has many forms, and is contained within all; how can I be fooled now? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam mo kau taar kahaa(n) lai jaee hai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, where will You take me, to save me?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਦੇਉ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sodhau mukat kahaa deu kaisee kar prasaad mohi paaee hai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Tell me where, and what sort of liberation shall You give me? By Your Grace, I have already obtained it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨੁ ਤਬੈ ਲਗੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taaran taran tabai lag kaheeai jab lag tat na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: People talk of salvation and being saved, as long as they do not understand the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਭਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ab tau bimal bhae ghat hee mahi kahi kabeer man maaniaa ||2||5||
lines.translation: I have now become pure within my heart, says Kabeer, and my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin gaR kot keee ka(n)chan ke chhod gaiaa so raavan ||1||
lines.translation: Raawan made castles and fortresses of gold, but he had to abandon them when he left. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀਜਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe keejat hai man bhaavan ||
lines.translation: Why do you act only to please your mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਤੇ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab jam aai kes te pakarai tah har ko naam chhadaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When Death comes and grabs you by the hair, then only the Name of the Lord will save you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਕਾਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੑਾ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਬਧਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal akaal khasam kaa keenhaa ihu parapa(n)ch badhaavan ||
lines.translation: Death, and deathlessness are the creations of our Lord and Master; this show, this expanse, is only an entanglement.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer te a(n)te mukate jinh hiradai raam rasaain ||2||6||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, those who have the sublime essence of the Lord in their hearts - in the end, they are liberated. ||2||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਰ ਮਹਤਉ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਿਰਸਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehee gaavaa jeeu dhar mahatau basahi pa(n)ch kirasaanaa ||
lines.translation: The body is a village, and the soul is the owner and farmer; the five farm-hands live there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੂ ਨਕਟੂ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੂ ਰਸਪਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nainoo nakatoo sravanoo rasapat i(n)dree kahiaa na maanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The eyes, nose, ears, tongue and sensory organs of touch do not obey any order. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਬ ਨ ਬਸਉ ਇਹ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa ab na basau ih gaau ||
lines.translation: O father, now I shall not live in this village.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਘਰੀ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਾਇਥੁ ਚੇਤੂ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gharee gharee kaa lekhaa maagai kaaith chetoo naau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The accountants summoned Chitar and Gupat, the recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, to ask for an account of each and every moment. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਬਾਕੀ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai jab lekhaa maagai baakee nikasee bhaaree ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for my account, there shall be a very heavy balance against me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਵਾ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਲੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜੀਉ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch krisaanavaa bhaag gae lai baadhio jeeu darabaaree ||2||
lines.translation: The five farm-hands shall then run away, and the bailiff shall arrest the soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਖੇਤ ਹੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu khet hee karahu niberaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: settle your accounts in this farm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ab kee baar bakhas ba(n)de kau bahur na bhaujal pheraa ||3||7||
lines.translation: O Lord, please forgive Your slave now, in this life, so that he may not have to return again to this terrifying world-ocean. ||3||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maaroo baanee kabeer jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anabhau kinai na dekhiaa bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: No one has seen the Fearless Lord, O renunciate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਅਨਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhai anabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Fear of God, how can the Fearless Lord be obtained? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahu hadoor dekhai taa(n) bhau pavai bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: If one sees the Presence of his Husband Lord near at hand, then he feels the Fear of God, O renunciate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hukamai boojhai ta nirabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||2||
lines.translation: If he realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he becomes fearless. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har paakha(n)d na keejaee bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: Don't practice hypocrisy with the Lord, O renunciate!

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d rataa sabh lok vanaaha(n)bai ||3||
lines.translation: The whole world is filled with hypocrisy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa paas na chhodaee bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: Thirst and desire do not just go away, O renunciate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa jaaliaa pi(n)d vanaaha(n)bai ||4||
lines.translation: The body is burning in the fire of worldly love and attachment. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa jaal tan jaaliaa bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: Anxiety is burned, and the body is burned, O renunciate,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: je man miratak hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||5||
lines.translation: only if one lets his mind become dead. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bin bairaag na hovaee bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there can be no renunciation,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: je lochai sabh koi vanaaha(n)bai ||6||
lines.translation: even though all the people may wish for it. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam hovai satigur milai bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: When God grants His Grace, one meets the True Guru, O renunciate,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje paavai soi vanaaha(n)bai ||7||
lines.translation: and automatically, intuitively finds that Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer ik benatee bairaageeaRe ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I offer this one prayer, O renunciate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau bhaujal paar utaar vanaaha(n)bai ||8||1||8||
lines.translation: Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||1||8||
